notes: Stage table for trackbed:workflow:suggest-next. scripts/inventory.py matches each entry's paths against the working directory by name only and never reads the files.
paths: a file path, a glob, or a directory with a trailing slash, relative to the working directory.

produced_by and next[].skill are skill names without the plugin prefix; the helper adds it and marks any next skill that is not installed. A <...> placeholder in args stands for one of the entry's matched paths.

The helper lists matched entries newest first. rank_after names entries that, when they also match, rank ahead of this one whatever the modification times: breakdown-findings writes PR_PLAN_INDEX.md after its plans, so the index would otherwise hide the plans' next steps.
Confirm every row against the producing and consuming skills' SKILL.md when either changes. A matched file is a hint about where the user is, not proof that a run finished.

artifacts.stage: A branch review report is waiting; its findings may not be fixed yet.

next.when: fix the report's findings as commits
the findings are too many for one PR and need PR-sized plans

next.when: fix the report's findings as commits

next.when: fix the report's findings as commits

next.when: fix the report's findings as commits

artifacts.stage: An overengineering review report is waiting; its findings may not be fixed yet.

artifacts.stage: A document review is written; the document has not necessarily been revised.

next.when: review the document again after revising it by hand
the document is an SIW specification that needs a full audit

artifacts.stage: Findings are planned as PR-sized plans; some may not be implemented yet.

next.when: implement, review, and ship one PR_PLAN_W##L_*.md plan as a PR
implement one PR_PLAN_W##L_*.md plan on the current branch without shipping
check which plans are already done

artifacts.stage: A PR plan index is written; some of its plans may not be implemented yet.

next.when: check which indexed plans are already done

artifacts.stage: A QA report is written; its issues, if any, may not be fixed yet.

next.when: turn the validated QA findings into PR-sized plans
trace the root cause of one reported bug first

artifacts.stage: A codebase audit is written; its findings are not planned yet.

next.when: plan the findings as PR-sized changes
clean up one small area directly

artifacts.stage: An agent-readiness audit is written; its findings are not planned yet.

next.when: plan the audit's findings as PR-sized changes

artifacts.stage: A dependency upgrade plan is written; its phases may not be applied yet.

next.when: re-run the audit to apply its low-risk Phase 2, or to get the siw:init command for its Phase 4 campaigns

artifacts.stage: An outsider's read of the codebase is written.

next.when: rank the weaknesses the outside view should be compared against
plan the confirmed findings as PR-sized changes

artifacts.stage: Strategic questions are written; they may still be open.

next.when: work through one question in depth
record a question that is now decided
a question turned into build work

artifacts.stage: A wayfinder decision map is charted; its frontier tickets may still be open.

next.when: resolve the next open ticket on the map

artifacts.stage: An SIW discovery brief is written.

next.when: create or link the specification from the brief

artifacts.stage: A spec-strengthening plan is waiting to be applied to the SIW specification.

next.when: fold the pending plan into the specification
audit the specification once the plan is applied

artifacts.stage: An SIW specification audit is written; its findings may be undecided.

next.when: decide each audit finding and update the specification

artifacts.stage: SIW issues are generated locally and not yet in Linear, unless a transfer already ran.

next.when: move the approved issue set to Linear
the transfer is verified and the local SIW files can go

artifacts.stage: An SIW workspace exists. Which step comes next depends on the files inside it.

next.when: the specification is not audited yet
the specification is ready to break into issues
